# NPT ensemble setup

# Thermo output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          1000

# Run quenching simulation
# Temperature change: 5000 - 1500 = 3500 K
# Quenching rate: 3.5 K/ps
# Time needed: 3500 / 3.5 = 1000 ps = 1000000 fs
run             1000000

# Write final structure
write_data      final_structure.dat
"}
